SCRIPT.ENGLISH: They’re asking what’s going on between you two...!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 啊，你们俩到底什么关系啊…！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 喂！你們兩個到底是什麼關係啦...！

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Mereka nanya hubungan kalian berdua tuh apa…!

SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 喂，你怎么了，又要来这套？
